title.en: Leave Room for the Unfinished Map

subtitle.en: An original reflection on evidence, imagination, and the dignity of revising what we think we know.
subtitle.zh: 一篇原创美文：关于证据、想象，以及修正既有认知的尊严。

sources.title: The Notebooks of Leonardo da Vinci
sources.author: Leonardo da Vinci; edited by Jean Paul Richter

note.en: Public-domain inspiration for close observation across art and science; this lesson is wholly original and reproduces no source wording.
note.zh: 灵感来自公开领域作品中贯通艺术与科学的细致观察；本课为全新原创，不复述原文。

warmup.en: Read with patient wonder. Keep the scientific language clear and the images light in the hand.
warmup.zh: 用耐心的惊奇感朗读。科学语言要清楚，意象要轻盈。

title.en: A Pencil Mark at the Edge of Knowledge
title.zh: 知识边缘的一道铅笔线

intro.en: This original passage explores why a changing map is evidence of attention, not failure.
intro.zh: 这篇原创文章探讨：一张不断修改的地图，为何证明了专注，而不是失败。

sections.text: Every serious map contains an admission: beyond this line, our knowledge thins. The admission may be printed as an empty coast, drawn as a dotted boundary, or hidden inside a confident color. In work and life, we often dislike such margins. We fill them with guesses, then forget which parts we invented. An artist and a scientist practice a different courage. They look long enough to separate what is present from what is merely expected. The blank is not an embarrassment. It is a clean place where attention can begin.

coaching.en: Give the first sentence quiet authority. Contrast present with expected without exaggeration.
coaching.zh: 第一句要有安静的权威感。present 与 expected 的对比不要夸张。

title.zh: 2. 画下光线所纠正的东西

sections.text: Imagine sketching a cup beside a window. At first, you draw the cup you remember: a neat oval, two straight sides, a familiar handle. Then the light objects. One edge disappears into brightness. The handle turns at an angle memory did not predict. A faint reflection bends across the table. Observation is not passive. It argues with the convenient picture in the mind. Science gives this argument measurements; art gives it pressure, tone, proportion, and space. Both ask the hand to become answerable to what the eye can actually find.

coaching.en: Make then the light objects playful but precise. Slow through pressure, tone, proportion, and space.
coaching.zh: then the light objects 要读得轻巧而准确。pressure、tone、proportion、space 的列举要放慢。

sections.text: A revised line is sometimes treated as proof that the first line was foolish. But revision is the visible form of learning. The astronomer updates a model when a movement refuses to fit. The designer reshapes a chair when the body reports discomfort. The listener changes an opinion when another person supplies the missing history. None of this requires a ceremony of shame. We can be grateful that reality is generous enough to resist us. An unfinished map stays alive because correction still has somewhere to land.

coaching.en: Keep the examples parallel and unhurried. Warm the voice on reality is generous enough to resist us.
coaching.zh: 几个例子要平行、从容。读到 reality is generous enough to resist us 时声音要温暖。

title.en: 4. Carry a Pencil, Not a Chisel

sections.text: Some convictions deserve ink: cruelty is not made kind by fashion, and another person’s dignity is not a temporary hypothesis. But many daily judgments should remain in pencil. The colleague who seemed distant may have been protecting bad news. The method that worked last year may now conceal a weakness. The talent we dismissed may be waiting for a different room. A pencil is not a symbol of indecision. It is a promise to keep looking. Leave a margin. Date the revision. Let the map become more faithful than your pride.

coaching.en: Make the moral boundary firm, then soften into the daily examples. End with three deliberate imperatives.
coaching.zh: 道德边界要读得坚定，日常例子则柔和下来。结尾三个祈使句要从容明确。

meaning.en: An acknowledgment that something is true.

use.en: The blank space was an admission of uncertainty.
use.zh: 空白处承认了不确定性。

meaning.en: The empty border around a page or the edge of an area.
meaning.zh: 页边空白；某个区域的边缘。

use.en: She left a margin for later notes.
use.zh: 她留出页边空白，方便以后做笔记。

meaning.en: The size or amount of one thing compared with another.
meaning.zh: 比例；一物与另一物在大小或数量上的关系。

use.en: The sketch captured the building’s proportion.
use.zh: 这幅素描抓住了建筑的比例。

meaning.en: Responsible and required to explain or respond.
meaning.zh: 须负责的；应作出解释或回应的。

use.en: Good judgment is answerable to evidence.
use.zh: 良好的判断应对证据负责。

meaning.en: A painful loss of pride or dignity.
meaning.zh: 羞辱；尊严或自尊受到伤害的感受。

use.en: Correction does not have to bring humiliation.

meaning.en: An idea proposed as a possible explanation to be tested.
meaning.zh: 假设；有待检验的可能解释。

use.en: The team tested its hypothesis against new data.
use.zh: 团队用新数据检验了假设。

pronunciationFocus.en: Hold a gentle pause after beyond this line.
pronunciationFocus.zh: 在 beyond this line 之后轻轻停顿。

pronunciationFocus.en: Shape the consonant clusters clearly in measurements, pressure, and proportion.
pronunciationFocus.zh: 清楚处理 measurements、pressure、proportion 中的辅音组合。

pronunciationFocus.en: Use firm falling intonation for Leave a margin. Date the revision.
pronunciationFocus.zh: Leave a margin. Date the revision. 使用坚定的降调。

prompt.en: Shadow as if you are inviting a creative team to welcome evidence without losing imagination.
prompt.zh: 跟读时，想象你在邀请一个创意团队：既欢迎证据，也不失去想象力。

steps.en: Pass one: make each image visible and unforced.
steps.zh: 第一遍：让每个意象清晰可见，又不刻意。

steps.en: Pass two: keep the art-and-science contrasts balanced.
steps.zh: 第二遍：保持艺术与科学之间的对比平衡。

steps.en: Pass three: finish with moral clarity and intellectual humility.
steps.zh: 第三遍：以道德上的清晰与认知上的谦逊收尾。

reflection.en: Where are you filling a blank margin with an untested guess?
reflection.zh: 你正在哪个空白处填入未经检验的猜测？

reflection.en: Which judgment in your life would be wiser in pencil?
reflection.zh: 生活中的哪个判断，用铅笔写会更明智？
